# SEFAS Group

> SEFAS Group is a diversified Indonesian business group, operating since 1997, built on partnerships that last. It grew from lubricants distribution into commercial fuels and energy retail.

## Lines of business

- Industrial solutions: lubricants, coolant and technical services that keep mines, plants and fleets running.
- Energy & mobility: commercial fuel for industry, and fuel retail for people on the road.
- Marine: marine lubricants and vessel services in Indonesian and international ports.
- Global distribution: warehousing and logistics that move products to where they are needed.

## Facts

- Customers: 6,000+
- Locations: 21
- Years of experience: 29
- Ports served worldwide: 600+
- Certifications: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001
